cells.gaps: The platform is agreed, not running: it is to start in several education departments in 2026/2027, with no school count and no level named, and routine entry of attendance and results (EGY-005) is what it is to do, not what any school is said to do, so levels and kept are left empty. Whether the 2023-2027 plan's integrated EMIS is this platform is not stated. Finance not stated. EGY-001 is from the excluded source and sets nothing.
cells.note: An agreement signed on 10 August 2026 for a named nationwide platform is preparation inside 36 months, which is stage 2. Stage 3 needs a system past its pilot and live in some primary schools, and no school is said to use this one.
